==Baelton==
Baelton is a sprawling, walled village home to several hundred "[[tieflings]]". It is the largest of [[Tief]]'s several holdings, where he keeps his tieflings. Baelton's gates are open to outsiders, but few non-tieflings wish to go here because of the disturbing appearance and powers of the tieflings.

===Hooks===
